title: Bernstein-type Theorems for constant mean curvature surfaces in the three-dimensional light cone
summary: We establish Bernstein-type theorems for entire constant mean curvature graphs in the three-dimensional light cone $\mathbb{Q}^3_+$ over the horosphere under the assumption that the Gaussian curvature $K$ is bounded below, by showing that such graphs are horospheres or spheres of $\mathbb{Q}^3_+$.
